'''Asset R-10''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="State" /> Around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.6}}</ref> R-10 was dispatched by the Shroud to investigate the recent deaths of Assets [[Asset R-3|R-3]], [[Asset R-27|R-27]], and [[Asset R-31|R-31]].<ref name="State" />
